tei:div.tei:p: bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub mtha' khyad 'phags sgo 'byed ni/ rnal 'byor pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub pa la lam gyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar byed pa gal che bas/ de 'joms par byed pa la gcod byed pa'i gdam ngag yin te/ gcod rang la'ang bdud bzhi yod de/ de gzhom dgos/ de la bzhi ste bdud bzhi ngos bzung ba dang*/ bdud bzhi lam du 'khyer thabs dang*/ lam du 'khyer shes pas bdud ma yin par bstan pa dang*/ gcod kyi chos la spyod pa dang bzhi'o/ / dang po la bdud kyi dbye ba bzhi ste/ thogs bcas kyi bdud dang*/ thogs med kyi bdud dang*/ dga' brod kyi bdud dang*/ snyems byed kyi bdud do/ / bdud kyi ngo bo ni/ thogs bcas kyi bdud ni/ me chu dug mtshon gcan gzan g.yang sa la sogs pa dbang po lnga'i yul du snang ba'i dngos po can 'di rnams yin no/ /thogs med kyi bdud ni/ phyi yi bdud lha 'dre dang mi kha gshe skur dang ngo tsha ba skyug bro ba'o/ /nang gi bdud nyon mongs pa dang*/ na tsha sdug bsngal chags sdang*/ chos brgyad nyam nga bag tsha la sogs pa yid yul gyi myong tshor la sogs phra rags dngos por med la sems la gzan pa 'di rnams yin no/ / dga' brod kyi bdud ni/ gcod kyi gdams ngag nyams su blangs pa la brten nas phyi ru mi tshugs/ nang na na tsha dang sdug bsngal zhi ba/ nus pa dang byin rlabs 'byung ba/ nad dang mdze sos pa dang*/ khams 'dus dang snying rlung drag po dang*/ zang zing dang*/ bsam blo 'byung ba dang*/ snyan pa dang grags pa 'byung ba dang*/ phyi nang gi yon tan rgya chen po 'byung ba la dga' ba dang brod pa skyes pa dang*/ da gzod 'byung ba la re ba dang bcas pa dang*/ 'dod pa dang bcas dga' ba dang bcas/ brod pa dang bcas/ phan yon dang bcas/ 'bras bu dang bcas pa la dmigs nas gcod byed pa'o/ / snyems byed kyi bdud ni/ dur khrod dang lung stong*/ 'brog dgon pa la sogs pa'i gnyan khrod rnams su phyin yang bdag la bar chad kyis gnod pa mi 'byung ste/

de ci'i phyir na bdag la lha dang bla mas spyan gyis gzigs/ dkon mchog gsum gyis thugs rjes skyob/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gros srung skyob byed/ ster nus na 'dre yong mi nus 'khyer mi nus bza' mi nus/ kho rang log nas 'gro bas de ltar byas pas chog snyam pa'i bsam pas gcod byed pa'o/ / bdud bzhis bar du gcod tshul ni/ thogs bcas thogs med gnyis ni/ rgyu'i dus kyi bdud yin pas rgyu dus su bar du gcod/ snyems byed ni lam gyi dus kyi bar chad yin pas/ nyams len gyi bar du gcod/ dga' brod ni 'bras bu'i dus kyi bdud yin pas/ 'bras bu skye ba la bar du gcod/ bdud snga ma gnyis ni lam gyi dus su spong*/ phyi ma gnyis ni 'bras bu thob pas spong ba'o/ / phyi ma gnyis ni bdud du btags pa ste lam gyi dus su snyems thag bcad nas lus srog thed la 'dor ma nus/ bdag 'dzin gyis ma thengs par yon tan gyi bogs mi thon pa'i phyir ro/ /gcod kyi 'bras bu la/ dga' brod skyes na yon tan 'gags pas dga' brod med par nyams su blang*/ de bas sangs rgyas la'ang re ba med pa zhig dgos so/ /des dga' brod dang snyems byed nas dngos por zhen gyis dogs nas spang bar bya'o/ / bdud bzhi ngos bzung ba ni thogs bcas kyi bdud dang thogs med kyi bdud dang*/ dga' brod kyi bdud dang*/ snyems byed kyi bdud do/ /bdud bzhi lam du 'khyer thabs ni/ ma rig pa'i dgra bdud ces bya ste/ ma rtogs bar du skyon bdud yin la/ rtogs na yon tan sdud par byed pa'o/ /gcod pa'i dus ni sa ma thob pa'i gang zag tshogs lam sbyor lam la gnas pa rnams kyi 'jig rten pa'i lam yin pas de'i dus su rten dbang che/ brten pa sems kyi dbang ma thob pas nang sdug bsngal la sogs pa mi 'dod bzhin du 'ong*/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes ma thob pas 'byung ba bzhi la thogs/ de'i dus thogs bcas kyi bdud la gcad par dka' bas/

thogs med kyi bdud la gcad par bya ste/ lha 'dre dang na tsha/ sdug bsngal dang chags sdang chos brgyad la sogs pa yid yul gyi myong tshor phra rags rnams yin te/ de ni sa ma thob kyang gnyen po dang ldan pas tshogs sbyor du gcad/ mthong lam thob pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam yin pas/ thogs bcas kyi bdud 'byung ba bzhi dang*/ dug dang mtshon la sogs pa la gcod par nus/ 'on kyang da dung sangs rgyas kyi sa la ma slebs pas lam sbyangs dgos te/ lam du dka' ba spyad kyang na tsha dang sdug bsngal mi myong bas/ dka' spyad ltar snang tsam yin te/ ngal ba dang dub pa med do/ /dper na rtag tu ngus lus sbyin par btang ba'am/ nā ro pa me dang g.yang la mchongs pa lta bu yin pas bar chad du mi 'gyur te/ sa thob 'jigs pa lnga dang bral/ /zhes so/ /de'i dus su thogs bcas kyi bdud bcad do/ /rtogs pa ma shar kyi bar du snyems 'ong bas snyemasabyed kyi bdud gcad dgos so/ /rtogs pa shar nas yon tan la dga' ba dang brod pa skyes na dga' brod kyi bdud gcad dgos/ lam du 'khyer shes na bdud ma yin par bstan pa ni/ thogs med kyi bdud gang gcad dka' ba de la gcod byas nas chod pa dang yon tan gyi sgo 'byed pa ste nang du bde sdug snyoms/ phyi ru 'khor 'das ro snyoms par 'gyur te yon tan gyi sna 'dren yin pa'i phyir bdud ma yin no/ /thogs bcas kyi bdud dngos por snang ba rnams la nyams len gyi drod thob/ ngar dang bcas/ rtogs pa'i gdengs dang bcas/ me dang chu la sogs pa 'byung ba bzhi la gcod nus pa de tsa na rdzu 'phrul 'char ba'i sna 'dren/ gzhan don 'byung ba'i grogs byed pa'i phyir bdud ma yin no/ /snyems byed kyi bdud ni nang du nyams len gyi gdengs thob/ dge sbyor gyi drod skyes/ nyams kyi nus pa rnyed pa de yin te/ snyems byed med na gcod kyi nyams len dang gdams ngag med pa'i phyir/

gcod la 'gro mi nus pas/ las dang po pa rnams kyis gcod byed pa'i dus su snyems dgos te/ cho 'phrul byung ba'i dus su stong nyid kyi rgyab tshan dgos/ gtong phod kyi blo stobs dgos/ nyams len gyi gdengs dgos pas de kho na snyems yin te bdud ma yin/ dga' brod kyi bdud ni/ gcod byed pa'i dus na tsha dang bde sdug mtho dman 'gal rkyen bar chad ci byung yang dga' bar blta ste/ de ci'i phyir na rkyen de la brten nas 'gal rkyen des sgrib pa 'dag /las ngan 'dzad/ dge sbyor gyi bogs thon lam gyi gegs sel/ chos pa'i pho shan phyed pa yin no/ / sngon gyi grub thob rnams kyis kyang 'gal rkyen lam du 'khyer ba la brten nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa yin pas bdag gis kyang bde sdug ro snyoms lam du khyer bas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub brnyes par byed pa 'di ni dga' brod kyi bdud do/ /des na ji srid rtogs pa ma shar zhing snang ba bden 'dzin ma log gi bar du dga' brod snyems byed gnyis spang yang mi nus la spang yang mi dgos/ rtogs pa shar bden 'dzin log na ma spangs kyang rang spangs la 'gro ste/ dper na rgun 'khyag pa bzhus kyang 'khyags su 'gro la/ sos ka ma bzhus kyang zhu nas 'gro ba bzhin no/ / gcod la rtsod pa spong ba la gsum ste/ gcod kyi rnam gzhag dang*/ gnas tshul dang*/ gcod la rtsod pa 'god pa'o/ /dang po ni phyi nang gi skyon thams cad 'joms pa'i gnyen po dang ldan pa'o/ /dbye ba ni/ gcod yul la dbye na/ phyi bdud 'dre la gcad pa/ nang bdud sems la gcad pa/ gsang ba'i bdud 'gal rkyen thams cad la gcad pa'o/ /gcod byed pa'i gnyen po la dbye na/ kun rdzob thabs kyi dbye bas gcad pa/ don dam shes rab kyis gcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa gcod kyi gnas tshul ni/ spang bya gnyen po rang bzhin med pa'i mtshan gzhi gcod kyi thad du mtshon te/ mtshan nyid gcad yul gcod byed rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa'o/

/bdud kyi gcod yul 'di'i mtshan gzhi/ 'gal rkyen bar chad 'joms pa'i gnyen po yin/ gcod byed rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i gnyen po blo gros/ gcod yul stong par shes pa'i phyir ro/ / dper na rdo rje pha lam gyis dngos po gzhan 'joms pa bzhin no/ /kun rdzob thabs kyis gcad pa dang*/ don dam shes rab kyis gcad pa thal lo/ /gcod kyi tshul ni spang bya dang gnyen po rang bzhin med pa'o/ /dpe gong song gis gcod kyi gnas tshul bstan pa'o/ / gcod la rtsod pa spong ba ni/ gcod nyams su len pa'i tshe na gcad yul de gcod pa'i gnyen po gcig yod dam med/ yod na bdud bzhi bcad kyang mi chod par thal/ gcod pa'i gnyen po yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na gcod kyi dam bca' bud de/ ma chod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyen po yod pas ma chod pa'i gtan tshig ma grub ste zhe na/ gtan tshig grub ste gnyen po kho na snyems byed kyi bdud yin pa'i phyir/ de min na snyems byed kyi bdud de gang la 'jog /gnyen po med kyang bdud bzhi chod na/ bcad kyang mi chod par thal/ gcod byed kyi gnyen po med pa'i phyir/ dper na me dang bral ba'i bud shing bzhin/ 'dir gnyen po yod pas mi chod pa'i skyon med do/ /gnyen po de lam gyi dus su gcad bya ma yin te nyams len gyi gdengs med pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na snyems byed bdud ma yin par thal zhe na/ lam gyi dus su bdud ma yin par 'dod/ 'bras bu'i dus su bdud ma yin pa'i khas len ma grub bo/ /gcod la 'gro ba'i sngon du/ skyabs 'gro byas nas bdag la bsrung du gsol/ bskyab tu gsol zer ram mi zer/ zer na bdud bzhi chos can/ bcad kyang mi chod par thal/ gcod mkhan gyi phung po gzan du skyur ma nus pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro byas nas bsrung du gsol zer ba'i phyir ro/ /dper na khas nyen pa skyel ma la bcol ba bzhin no/

/mi zer na lung la snang bas bsal te bka' tshoms las/ bdag re hrul dang*/ khang stong dang*/ dur khrod dang bla gab med pa na 'dug kyang bsrung du gsol bskyab tu gsol zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir skyabs 'gro byas pa la skyon med de/ bsrung du gsol bskyab tu gsol mi zer/ lus kyis bdag 'dzin blos thongs par/ bde sdug ro snyom par/ 'gal rkyen lam du slong bar/ gcod mthar phyin par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zer ro/ /'o na bka' tshoms las bsrung du gsol zhes sogs bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te blo tha ma gcod byed thog nas gcod byed pa la dgongs pa'o zhes bya'o/ /gcod kyi gdams pa nyams su len pa'i sngon du sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i phyir du bdag gis gcod kyi gdams pa nyams su blang snyam pa'i sems bskyed byed dam mi byed/ byed na gcod byed mkhan chos can/ gcod nyams su blangs kyang dga' brod kyi bdud mi chod par thal/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la dmigs pa de dga' brod kyi bdud yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na gcod kyi dam bca' bud/ dga' brod kyi bdud mi chod pa'i phyir/ sems bskyed mi byed na gcod kyi gdams pa 'di chos can/ theg chen gyi lam ma yin par thal/ gzhan don du byang chub 'dod pa'i sems bskyed med pa'i phyir/ 'dir sems bskyed kyang 'gal ba med de rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la dga' brod 'cha' ba de/ lam gyi dus na gcad bya ma yin te/ nyams su blangs pa'i dgos pa yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar na dga' brod de bdud ma yin par thal/ 'dod na a ma jo mos bdud du bshad pas bsal zhe na/ lam nyams su len pa'i dus su bdud ma yin par 'dod de/ 'bras bu yon tan la bsams nas lam la 'jug par spro ba'i phyir/ 'bras bu'i dus su bdud ma yin pa'i khas len ma grub/ sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la re ba med pa zhig dgos pa'i phyir/

gcod kyi gdams pa nyams su len pa'i sngon du snod rung gi dbang bskur ram mi bskur/ bskur na pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos ma yin par thal/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum nas dbang bskur ma bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos su bsal/ lung thams cad pha rol tu phyin pa nas drangs pa'i phyir ro/ / mi bskur na nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyis sgom ngo sprod du mi btub par thal/ tshig dbang ma thob pa'i phyir/ rtags kyi tshig dbang ma thob par chos nyid ngo sprod du mi btub par lung gis grub bo/ /'dir pha rol tu phyin pa nas ma bshad kyang dbang bskur dgos te/ thabs gsang sngags dang 'brel ba'i phyir/ nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi ngo sprod skabs su chos nyid rtsol med ma bcos pa zhig ngo sprod dam/ rtsol bcas bcos ma zhig ngo sprod/ dang po ltar na ngo sprod chos can/ rtsol med du 'dod kyang rtsol bcas su thal/ ngo sprod kyi dus su kag se langs thal mo spyi bor sbyar ba dang ngag tu phaṭa 'debs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na ma rtsol ma bcos par ngo sprod pa'i dam bca' bud/ rtsol bcas la ngo sprad pa'i phyir/ gal te rtsol med la ngo sprod par/ lus gnad kag se langs pa dang thal mo spyi bor sbyar mi dgos pa'i phyir/ dmigs pa'i gnad sems nyid lus la bkab nas gnas so zhe na/ sems snying khar sdud dam mi sdud/ sdud na sems nyid chos can/ dngos po can du thal/ sdud rgyu zhig yod pa'i phyir/ dper na thang sman btang bas rtsa sgor nad sdud pa bzhin/ 'dod na/ dngos po yod par thal lo/ /dngos po med par sdud dgos zhe na/ khyab pa ma grub ste/ dngos po med pa la bsdu mi dgos pas khyab ste/ bsdu rgyu med pa'i phyir/ dper na nam mkha' la bsdus kyang dngos po med par gnas pa bzhin no/ rig pa gang du gnas kyang de nyid du bzhag pas chog ste/ stong pa nyid du gnas pa'i phyir/ sems nyid spyi bo nas 'phangs nas nam mkha' la bsre bar 'dod dam mi 'dod/

'dod na sems nyid chos can/ dngos po rdzas su grub par thal/ spyi bo nas 'phang rgyu yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na rdzas su ma grub par thal/ stong nyid du 'dug pa'i phyir/ 'phang rgyu med na 'phang ba'i dam bca' bud/ 'phang rgyu med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na sems nyid chos can dngos po can du thal/ bsre rgyu yod pa'i phyir/ dngos po med pa la bsre rgyu med de/ nam mkha' nam mkha' dang bsre rgyu med pa bzhin no/ /bsres pas 'dres sam mi 'dre/ 'dres na 'dres par 'dod kyang mi 'dres par thal/ sems la bde cha stong cha gnyis yod de/ nam mkha' la stong cha tsam zhig yod kyang bde cha med pa'i phyir ro/ /mi 'dre na bsres pa don med du thal/ bsres kyang mi 'dre ba'i phyir/ nam mkha' dang bsre bar mi 'dod na ngo sprod kyi skabs su sems nyid spyi bo nas 'phangs nas nam mkha' dang bsre ba'i dam bca' bud/ nam mkha' sgo 'byed 'di gcod kyis ngo sprod du 'dod dam/ btsan thabs kyis 'pho bar 'dod/ dang po ltar na nam mkha' sgo 'byed chos can/ chos nyid ngo sprod du 'dod kyang btsan thabs kyis 'pho bar thal lo/ nyams len 'pho ba kho nar 'dus pa'i phyir/ 'dod na ngo sprod yin pa'i dam bca' bud/ ngo sprod 'pho ba gnyis gcig pas khyab pa ma grub ce na/ gcig par 'dod kyang tha dad du thal/ ngo sprod nang du rig pa stong nyid la 'pho ba rig pa rten can du phyir la 'phen pa'i phyir/ btsan thabs su 'pho bar 'dod na/ nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi ngo sprod 'di chos can/ yang dag pa'i lam ma yin te/ phung po la bsnyas pa'i phyir ro/ /gtan tshig 'chi ltas ma byung gi sngon du 'pho bar byed pas grub bo/ /'dir gang yang de rnams mi 'dod pas sngar gyi skyon de rnams med do/ /gcod kyi gdams pa 'di pha rol tu phyin pa'i gdams pa yin nam nang gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag yin/ dang po ltar na gcod kyi gdams ngag 'di chos can/

pha rol tu phyin pa'i gdams ngag tu 'dod kyang gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag tu thal/ nyams len thams cad rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i chos su 'dug pa'i phyir/ de 'dod na pha rol du phyin pa'i gdams ngag yin pa'i dam bca' bud/ nang gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag yin zhe na/ gcod kyi gdams pa chos can/ gsang sngags kyi gdams par 'dod kyang pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos su thal/ lung thams cad phar phyin nas drangs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na sngags kyi chos yin pa'i dam bca' bud/ de gnyis gcig pas khyab pa ma grub zhe na/ khyab pa grub ste/ rjod byed kyi lam tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir kun rdzob thabs kyi khyad par sngags dang 'brel yang don dam shes rab kyi ngo bo phar phyin dang 'brel ba yin no zhes bya'o/ /gnyan khrod du lha 'dre la lus ster ba'i tshe na/ nga'i lus mi gtsang ba'i phung po/ rnag khrag gi rkyal pa ngar snabs kyi sdong po 'di khyod la ster bas khyod khyer cig zer ram mi zer/ zer na lus kyi sbyin pa chos can/ btang yang bsod nams mi 'byung bar thal/ bdag la mi mkho ba'i dngos po ma dag pa'i sbyin pa btang ba'i phyir/ mi zer na lung gis bsal te/ bka' tshoms dang yang tshoms las bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir nga'i lus mdzes shing gtsang ba yid du 'ong ba gces shing mkho la med thabs pa med pa 'di khyod la sbyin par gtong byas nas ster ba'o/ /

gcod nyams su len pa'i tshe/ dga' brod dang snyems byed kyi bdud spangs sam mi spong*/ spangs na snyems byed kyi bdud chos can/ spangs kyang mi spong bar thal/ spong byed kyi gnyen po'ang spang bya'i bdud yin pa'i phyir/ dper na nad thams cad sman gyis spong ba'i tshe sman ma 'ju nas dug tu song ba bzhin no/ /mi spong na gcod kyi gdams ngag nyams su blangs pa don med par thal/ bdud gnyis mi spong ba'i phyir ro/ /gcod byed pa'i tshe na 'gal rkyen byung ba'i dus su gnyen po brten nam mi brten/ bsten na snyems byed kyi bdud ma chod par thal/ gnyen po de snyems byed yin pa'i phyir/ mi brten na 'byung pos bar chod du byung na ji ltar byed/ sbyin nas brten zer na/ gnyen po mi brten pa'i dam bca' bud/ ster ba de kho na gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ gcod byed pa'i dus su nyams su blang rgyu'i gdams ngag yod dam med/ yod na de nyid snyems byed kyi bdud du thal/ gdam ngag de kho na snyems byed yin pa'i phyir/ med na gcod nyams su len pa'i dam bca' bud/ gcod kyi gdams ngag med pa'i phyir/ dga' brod snyems byed gnyis lam gyi dus su spang byar mi 'dod pas skyon de rnams dang bral lo/ / thogs bcas thogs med gnyis ni spang bya'i bdud yin la/ dga' brod snyems byed gnyis ni lam dus su spong byed kyi gnyen po yin no/ /de gnyis lam la mchog tu zhen na bdud yin/ 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'i dus su spang bya spong byed gnyis ka las grol te dper na spang bya mi dge ba bcu'i gnyen po spong byed dge ba bcu brten pas/ lam du de gnyis dgra zin yin na'ang*/ 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'i dus su dge sdig gnyis mi 'dod pa bzhin no/ / gzhan yang lha 'dre slong rtags dang zlog rtags/ log gnon dang tshar tshad la sogs pa mi 'thad pa'i skyon dgag pa dang 'thad pa'i 'dod pa dgod pa sogs rtsod gzhi mang du snang ste yi ge mang gis dogs nas rgya cher ma bkod do/

/'di dag ni gal che ba 'ga' zhig las nyung shas tsam zhig bkod pa'o/ / grub mtha' khyad 'phags sgo 'byed rdzogs so// // gcod mkhan don du gcod byed rgyas po ngas/ /zab rgyas nyung bsdus gcod kyi nying khu 'di/ /gcod la brten nas gcod kyi gdams pa brtsams/ /gcod 'di nyams blangs gcod don rtogs par shog /bka' rgyud nyams rgyud yum lugs sras lugs bka' ma gter ma kha 'thor khrid bcas kyi dgongs pa lhan cig tu bsdus pa'i zhal gdams sgo 'byed bcu'i rdza chas rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (26)grub mtha' khyad 'phags sgo 'byed/ - PAGE 76 -- PAGE 77 -- PAGE 70 -
